name: AInsteinBench
intro: AInsteinBench 用 244 道可执行任务评测编码 Agent 在六个科学软件仓库中的端到端开发能力。真实仓库缺陷任务经过历史 Docker 与 Fail-to-Pass 验证；论文明确披露的合成通道以 Einstein Toolkit 模块消融为例。两类候选统一经过科学相关性、难度和测试覆盖专家审核。
build_method: 科学缺陷PR筛选、历史环境与Fail-to-Pass验证、条件式Minimal API补充、Einstein Toolkit模块消融及统一专家审核
metric: 问题解决率；按领域、Issue定位、难度与迭代效率分项
eval_feature: 隔离Docker中的CodeAct计划-行动循环、可执行测试、Issue定位与迭代效率
build_method_en: Scientific-bug PR screening, historical-environment and fail-to-pass verification, conditional Minimal API supplementation, Einstein Toolkit module ablation, and shared expert review
eval_feature_en: CodeAct plan-act loop in isolated Docker, executable tests, issue localization, and iteration efficiency
intro_en: AInsteinBench evaluates coding agents on 244 executable tasks across six scientific repositories. Repo-crawled bug tasks undergo historical-Docker and fail-to-pass verification; the paper's concrete synthesis path ablates Einstein Toolkit modules. Both candidate streams enter shared expert review for scientific relevance, difficulty, and test coverage.
metric_en: Resolved-problem rate with domain, issue-localization, difficulty, and iteration-efficiency analyses
drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2512.21373v1 §3.1–§3.5, §4.1, Appendix A, and ByteDance-Seed/AInsteinBench@d9b1383e86c2ae43dcb3ddbcaf34c21ceb786cca. Six repositories are chosen for acceptance, breadth, maintenance, and reproducible unit tests. The repo lane crawls all pull requests, retains merged scientific or numerical bugs with test updates while excluding documentation, refactors, and large features, rebuilds PR-era Docker environments, and verifies base-pass/test-patch-fail/fix-patch-pass behavior. Minimal API text is a conditional feature-request supplement: APIs come from the fix diff and only test-used symbols are retained. The paper's concrete synthesis source is Einstein Toolkit modules; use of other repositories for synthesis is not disclosed. Ablated tasks use documentation, interfaces, remaining context, and simulation/parameter/output checks that accept any passing implementation. Both candidate streams enter one shared human-verification stage for scientific clarity, 10-PhD-expert scientific/engineering difficulty scores from 1 to 5, test undercoverage/overcoverage, and false-positive/false-negative controls. The release has 244 tasks across six repositories. CodeAct evaluation reports resolved rate plus domain, issue-localization, difficulty, and iteration-efficiency analyses.
